observations: Photo 0: Nikon DSLR body shown on a table; top cover has 'Nikon' branding and the model marking appears to be 'D610'.
Photo 1: Similar front view of the same Nikon DSLR body; no lens is clearly shown.
Photo 2: Rear/side view showing the rear LCD and control dials; no lens, battery, charger, or accessories are clearly visible in the frame.

claims.claim: Used Nikon D610 in good condition.
claims.evidence: Photos show the body, but do not confirm sensor health, shutter count, autofocus, or full functionality.

claims.claim: May show sign of cosmetic wears.
claims.evidence: Cosmetic wear is not clearly measurable from these photos (lighting/glare); only general condition can be seen.
No battery/charger/accessories are visible in the provided photos.

risks.risk: Missing or unshown accessories (battery/charger/lens). If it’s body-only, value drops.
risks.proof: A photo showing all included items laid out (battery, charger, cables, strap, and lens if any) with the camera in the same shot.
risks.if_unproven: Price as camera body only (no lens, no charger, no extra battery).

risks.risk: Functionality issues (shutter, autofocus, buttons, LCD, ports) not testable from photos.
risks.proof: A short video powering on and showing: live view, menu navigation, autofocus on a target, and a shutter actuation sound/shot preview.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully verified (assume worst case: needs testing/possible faults).

risks.risk: Sensor dust/fungus or internal haze (common risk) not visible here.
risks.proof: A test shot of a blank white wall at f/16 (or similar) plus a close photo of the sensor area (mirror up) if possible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially dusty (worst case for usability).

risks.risk: LCD condition (dead pixels/lines) not clearly confirmed.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the LCD showing a menu screen and playback screen.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming LCD may be imperfect (worst case).

proof_requests: Photo of the full set of included items (battery, charger, strap, and lens if any) laid out clearly.
Close-up of the rear LCD showing a menu screen (to confirm no dead pixels/lines).
Video: power on + menu navigation + live view + autofocus on a subject + one captured image preview.
A sensor test shot (blank wall/sky) at a small aperture to reveal dust/fungus.
response.reason: The photos identify the camera as a Nikon D610, but the key pricing drivers (whether it includes battery/charger/lens and whether it works properly) are not verifiable from the provided images.
